Octave version: 11.3.0

```{octave}
% Set up environment
clear all;

pkg load statistics


% Read in data
fid = fopen('dat/ANOVA/anova_python_vieira.csv', 'r');

data = textscan(fid, '%q %f %q %q %q %f', 'Delimiter', ',', 'HeaderLines', 1);

fclose(fid);

% Get columns
condition = data{4};
rating    = data{6};

% Run anova
[p, atab, stats] = anova1(rating, condition, 'off');

SS_effect = atab{2,2}; % between-groups Squared Sum
SS_total  = atab{4,2}; % Total Squared Sum (between + error for 1-way ANOVA)

df_num = atab{2,3}
df_den = atab{3,3}
F_stat = atab{2,5}
p
eta_sq = SS_effect / SS_total
```
